- **[Quickstart](https://docs.fly.io/getting-started/launch):** Launch your own app now.
- **[Launch hellofly demo app](https://docs.fly.io/getting-started/launch-demo):** Walk through installing the flyctl command-line tool and creating an account, then launch a simple “hellofly” demo app.
- **[Deep dive demo](https://docs.fly.io/deep-dive):** get a fully-functioning app running in the first few minutes and explore how the pieces fit together.
- **[Choose your language or framework](https://docs.fly.io/getting-started/get-started-by-framework):** Get started on Fly.io with the tech _you_ love.
- **[Fly.io essentials](https://docs.fly.io/getting-started/essentials):** A primer on Fly Machines and Fly Launch, plus the Fly.io glossary. It’s all here.

## [​](https://docs.fly.io/getting-started\#learn-more)  Learn more

- [Fly Launch](https://docs.fly.io/apps): You’ve tried the `fly launch` command. Now learn how to use all the Fly Launch features that help you manage and run your apps.
- [Going to production checklist](https://docs.fly.io/apps/going-to-production): Considerations for setting up a production environment on Fly.io.
- [Fly.io Blueprints](https://docs.fly.io/blueprints): A library of patterns and examples that you can apply in your own projects.
- [Databases & Storage](https://docs.fly.io/database-storage-guides): Options for persistent data storage on Fly.io.
- [Fly Machines](https://docs.fly.io/machines): Go deeper with our fast-launching VMs, and use them to run your projects and tasks.
- [Networking](https://docs.fly.io/networking): How to connect to an app service, use a custom domain, and take advantage of private networking and dynamic request routing.
